name: sink-json
title: JSON Sink
description: JSON sink that serializes wide events for streaming or files.
docs: Wire the sink: add `import { jsonFileSink } from "./sinks/json"` to telemetry/logger.ts and append `jsonFileSink()` to the init() sinks array; add amplio.jsonl to .gitignore. Prefer `npx @useamplio/cli@alpha add sink json` — it wires all of this for you.
